# Stockfish.js 19.0.1

Unmodified **Stockfish.js 19 Lite, single-threaded WebAssembly**, from the
[v19.0.1 release](https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/releases/tag/v19.0.1).
Copyright 2026 Chess.com, LLC and the Stockfish contributors.

Distributed under GNU GPL version 3; see [Copying.txt](./Copying.txt).
The complete corresponding source and build instructions for these exact files
are available at:

- https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/tree/v19.0.1
- https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js/archive/refs/tags/v19.0.1.tar.gz

The Lite network is embedded in the WASM; no external neural network file is needed.
Keep the JS and WASM files in the same directory and serve over HTTP(S).
